label: PF Backlog 255
title: F1.0 Observability to industry standard (OTel, trace context, event sourcing, SLIs, 12-factor)
body: Adopt OTel + GenAI semconv (span per agent/LLM/tool call), W3C trace context (trace_id=run_id), structured JSONL logging, event-sourcing/CQRS (state derived from the unified stream), three pillars + SLIs/SLOs, 12-factor, per-run trace UI, idempotency/checkpoint/DLQ/backpressure, retention/redaction. Relates BI-0199, BI-PF-0233/0234/0235. Source: LOGS-AND-OBSERVABILITY.md App. D.
